corrected_value.authors: Zamboanga BL, Perrotte JK, Newins AR, Martin JL, Ford K, Wyrick DL, & Milroy JJ
corrected_value.title: Masculine drinking norms and alcohol use in a national sample of NCAA male student-athletes.

decisions.quote:
Thus, we sought to replicate and extend prior work on 
the MDNM using a large, multisite sample of college men. Our study aims are to investigate 
the factor structure and item loadings of the MDNM, and examine the extent to which 
excess and control are associated with alcohol use and negative drinking consequences 
over and above known demographic correlates of alcohol use including age, membership 
in a Greek fraternity and/or athletic involvement (e.g., Meilman et al., 1999; Merrill & 
Carey, 2016; Zhou & Heim, 2014) and general masculine norms (CMNI-29). Based on prior 
research (Perrotte et al., 2020; Zamboanga et al., 2023), we expected to find a two-factor 
solution (i.e., excess and control) of the MDNM in this multisite sample of college men. 
We also expected excess to be positively associated with alcohol use and negative drinking 
consequences and control to be negatively related to both drinking outcomes.
decisions.reason: The primary source (Zamboanga et al., 2025, DOI 10.1037/men0000497) collects new multisite survey data (N = 1,350 college men across 12 universities) to empirically retest the two-factor structure (excess and control) of the Masculine Drinking Norms Measure (MDNM) and its multivariate associations with alcohol use (AUDIT-C) and negative drinking consequences (B-YAACQ) over and above demographic covariates and CMNI-29 masculine norms, explicitly naming both Perrotte et al. (2020) and Zamboanga et al. (2023) as the prior MDNM studies being replicated and directly comparing the CFA factor structure, positive excess associations, and null control associations against Zamboanga et al. (2023) in the Discussion (lines 634-642, 732-740). The References section (lines 1075-1078) provides the complete citation and DOI: Zamboanga BL, Perrotte JK, Newins AR, Martin JL, Ford K, Wyrick DL, & Milroy JJ (2023), 'Masculine drinking norms and alcohol use in a national sample of NCAA male student-athletes.', Psychology of Men & Masculinities, 24(3), 261-268, DOI 10.1037/men0000436. The only shipped row for this work is input_row_index 2484 (Perrotte, Zamboanga, & Kearns, 2020, DOI 10.1037/men0000252, matched to sibling blind target 0), which is a distinct prospective study of Latino college men; Zamboanga et al. (2023) is a separate empirical study of NCAA male student-athletes and is genuinely omitted from the shipped dataset.
